text: Completed the production NIfTI codec. The shared codec now performs header/extension bounded reads, sequential file-order payload conversion directly into the final Ravel NDArray builder, prevalidated chunked writes, explicit raw/scaled conversion, and typed limits for working buffers, payloads, decoded output, and extensions. JVM plain and gzip paths stream through reusable buffers; Node plain files are bounded while synchronous gzip deliberately reports WholeFileCompressedCompatibility via Nifti.ioStrategy. No second image owner was introduced. Verification: image4s-niftiJVM/test passed 29 tests; image4s-niftiJS/test passed 17 tests; optimized Scala.js NIfTI test passed all 17. Shared tests prove no whole-file payload calls on streaming adapters, every truncated payload byte boundary, typed resource failures, and extension bounds. JVM allocation court on Java 25.0.1 / Scala 2.13.16: Float32 3D read 581536 B / 14336 samples; Float32 4D read 1829872 B / 86016; Int16 labels read 184136 B / 14336; gzip Float32 4D read 1841648 B / 86016; Float32 4D write 5388896 B / 86016; gzip write 4210104 B / 86016. Independent count, sum, and weighted-sum checksums match. Existing dtype/endian, malformed header/extension, qform/sform, single/pair, gzip, and large round-trip courts remain green. README documents the supported subset and exact per-platform memory strategy.
